name: MINIMUM SPEED
spec: white vertical rectangle with black legend MINIMUM SPEED above large black numerals 40
meaning: Do not drive slower than this unless conditions require it.

snippets.back: Some signs post both a maximum and a minimum speed for a stretch of highway, and minimum limits usually appear on freeways and other controlled-access highways.
Speed-limit signs communicate the permitted maximum or minimum speed for a particular stretch of road.
Follow posted minimum speeds unless weather or other conditions make doing so unsafe.
Some highways have posted minimum speeds. If unable to meet the minimum, choose another route.

You must not exceed the posted maximum speed limit, must not drive below a posted minimum speed limit, and must not drive so slowly that you hold back other traffic, pulling off the road or changing route if you cannot keep up.
A freeway may display a minimum speed as well as its other speed controls.
Some high-speed roads post a minimum speed as well as a maximum; the handbook also requires slowing for poor conditions.
Use a headlight and space cushion on mopeds; helmets are optional but advised. Mopeds cannot use limited-access highways with minimum speeds over thirty miles per hour.

result.summary: Meaning supported: snippets require following / not driving below posted minimum unless unsafe. No snippet describes shape, colour, or legend.
